name: @nodeve/schema
description: Central schema source for describing things, authored as a relational LinkML model and projected for storage, validation, and code.

scripts.generate: node bin/prefixes.ts && node bin/format.ts && node normalize/catalog.ts && node bin/data2schema.ts
scripts.build: pnpm generate && pnpm build:types && pnpm build:jsonschema && pnpm check:catalog && pnpm build:ddl && pnpm build:db
scripts.build:types: cd linkml && uvx --from linkml gen-typescript nodeve.yaml > ../gen/schema.ts
scripts.build:jsonschema: cd gen && uvx --from linkml gen-json-schema -t Catalog --closed nodeve-projected.yaml > catalog.schema.json && node ../bin/stencil-link.ts
scripts.check: pnpm check:format && pnpm check:prefixes && pnpm check:meta && pnpm check:data && pnpm typecheck
